accepted_history_policy: same captured FP32 accepted 15-state history at center and every plus/minus endpoint; center candidate is only an initial numerical seed for endpoint continuation.
branch_predicates: multiplier-increment sign, yield-gap sign, elastic_smoothed/plastic_smoothed FB selector; continuous Hill q and hardening factor retained; no separate discrete hardening predicate exposed.
classification: One-row CPU FP64 diagnostic; no native, physical, or universal noise-floor qualification.
limits: Perturbation sweep is only for captured row1186 and direction.
No universal FP64 or native FP32 noise floor is inferred.
A target-specific pass does not change the full1728 one-epsilon result.

continuation_v3.method: stock projector candidate followed by safeguarded Newton residual descent; on stock failure only, use the already-converged center candidate as a numerical seed at target F. The accepted history remains the same captured FP32 old state for every center and endpoint.
continuation_v3.residual_metric: independent source-defined row scaling [1e4]*6+[1]*6+[1e4]*3, max norm; stop <=2e-10.
